overview.text: Saint Catherine’s parish explains the saint’s imperial garments, martyr’s cross, books, celestial sphere, and wheel as identifying attributes in her iconography.

blocks.text: The selected historic Sinai icon shows Catherine enthroned with books, instruments, and narrative scenes. Its whole composition is retained, including the surrounding episodes; it is not cropped to conceal contextual details.

blocks.text: The parish’s published life recounts Catherine’s learned defense of Christianity and her martyrdom, then connects her relics with the Sinai monastery. These are its hagiographic traditions. The selected icon is an illustration of her later veneration, not a contemporary record of the trial.
